pure-announcement.rationale: It is a product docs landing page rather than a launch, release note or funding announcement, and it does gesture at a transferable trade-off (static reachability versus runtime coverage) beyond the product itself.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest code-intelligence concepts (code knowledge graph, graph-vs-vector retrieval) cover combining static reachability with runtime coverage for deletion confidence.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims describe checkable tool behaviour documented at the source, not unverifiable assertions.

durability.rationale: The captured content is dominated by a vendor feature matrix (dead code, duplication, complexity, feature-flag branches, hot/cold paths) with mostly empty section headers, and only a thin durable kernel — the static-vs-runtime deletion-confidence trade-off — survives twelve months.

actionability.rationale: As captured it mostly says 'use fallow to find X'; the transferable decision (confirm static dead-code findings against runtime coverage before deleting) is present only as a one-line teaser, not developed enough to act on.

atomicity.rationale: It stays on one idea — two layers of codebase intelligence, static reachability and runtime coverage, meeting in a health check — statable in a single paragraph.
